bib.title: OS-Copilot: Towards Generalist Computer Agents with Self-Improvement

question: How can a general-purpose agent interface with a whole operating system and learn to control unfamiliar applications by accumulating tools?
hypothesis: A planner/configurator/actor design with a critic, self-correction and self-directed learning that stores generated tools lets one agent generalise to unseen applications.
contributions: OS-Copilot, a conceptual framework for generalist computer agents on Linux and MacOS with a unified interface
FRIDAY, a self-improving agent built on it, strong on GAIA and able to learn Excel and PowerPoint control

method.summary: OS-Copilot has a DAG planner, a configurator with declarative (user profile, semantic knowledge), procedural (tool repository) and working memory, and an actor (executor plus critic, refiner). FRIDAY seeds 4 tools, generates tools when dense retrieval finds none above a threshold, stores tools the critic scores above 8, and self-corrects up to three times; self-directed learning proposes a task curriculum for an unfamiliar app.
method.task: general computer-task automation / GAIA QA / spreadsheet control

datasets.name: GAIA
datasets.split: dev set used for tool accumulation (9 tools); private test set for scores via official server; levels 1-3 (93 level-1 test tasks manually checked in App B)

datasets.name: SheetCopilot-20
datasets.size: 20 spreadsheet tasks (selected from 221 by Li et al. 2023)

inference.samples: Pass@1: each task performed once; GAIA run submitted to the server; no seeds or repeats stated
inference.prompting: Zero-shot role prompts for planner, tool generator, refiner, executor and critic (Tables 5-9) filled with memory contents
inference.retrieval: Dense retrieval over long-term memory (tools, user profile, OS version, working directory); a tool is generated if similarities fall below 'a specified threshold'; the threshold value and embedding model are not given

parameters.seed_tools: 4 manually created (bing search, bing load page, audio2text, image caption)
parameters.critic_store_threshold: score above 8 on a 0-10 scale (prompt says integer 1-10)

other.control_methods: Python interpreter, bash, API calls, mouse/keyboard

limits: Relies on prompt engineering; performance may change drastically with the underlying LLM (App D).
Cannot control closed-source GUI applications; no screenshot input yet.
Web browsing is read-only (no clicks); weak on web browsing and multi-modal tasks (App B).
Evaluating subtask completion has no ground truth and LLM or rule checks may be inaccurate.
User profile module is conceptual only, untested.
GAIA run uses GPT4-turbo-1106 only; baseline backbones differ; single run with no variance; SheetCopilot-20 has only 20 tasks so one task is 5 points.
Safety of OS-acting agents not studied.
Retrieval threshold, temperature, and embedding model are unstated.
Learning gain on GAIA is 0 at level 3 and the dev/test overlap in tool reuse is not analysed.
